backend/main.mo: Actor storing per-user prompts and categories with CRUD operations and access control checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module initializing empty usersData map for the upgraded actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing frontend file purposes across prompts, categories, storage, and UI.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Guide outlining steps to diagnose and resolve deployment failures, including logs and common fixes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme color variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry document loading the React app and linking generated favicon assets.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component handling authentication, prompt/category state, backend sync, and UI layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Sign‑in screen component prompting users to authenticate via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/categories/Categ: Displays category badges and a favorites toggle to filter prompts by category or favorites.
Allows selecting, creating, and toggling multiple categories for a prompt.
frontend/src/components/categories/Manag: Provides UI to rename or delete categories with usage checks and confirmation prompts.
frontend/src/components/importExport/Imp: Handles exporting prompts to JSON and importing prompts/categories from a file with backend sync.
frontend/src/components/prompts/ConfirmD: Generic confirmation dialog with title, description, and confirm/cancel actions.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptAc: Renders action buttons for copying, favoriting, duplicating, editing, and deleting a prompt.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptCo: Displays sanitized HTML prompt content safely inside the UI.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEd: Dialog for creating or editing a prompt with rich text, categories, and favorite settings.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptGr: Shows prompts in a responsive card grid with previews, categories, and action controls.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptLi: Renders prompts as a list of cards with categories, content preview, and action controls. Handles empty-state display and delegates edit, delete, duplicate, and favorite actions.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptPr: Shows a modal dialog previewing a prompt’s title and content. Opens when a prompt is selected and closes via onOpenChange.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptTa: Displays prompts in a table with title, categories, modified date, and actions, and supports click-to-preview via a dialog. Manages preview state and handles empty-state display.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchInp: Provides a styled search input with an icon and change handler. Used to filter prompts by text.
frontend/src/components/sorting/SortDrop: Select dropdown for choosing prompt sort mode. Emits changes using provided callback.
frontend/src/components/views/ViewModeTo: Toggle buttons for switching between list, grid, and table view modes. Highlights the active mode and triggers updates via callback.
frontend/src/features/auth/iiProviderLog: Implements full Internet Identity provider logout, including URL validation, logout URL construction, navigation, and pending-state tracking. Ensures safe provider handling and preserves return URLs.
frontend/src/features/auth/logoutReturnU: Returns a fixed post-logout return URL containing a required admin token hash. Used for Internet Identity redirect.
frontend/src/features/auth/useReliableII: Custom hook coordinating reliable II logout by clearing local auth state, waiting for anonymous identity, then navigating to provider logout. Tracks loading and error state.
frontend/src/features/backend/promptLibr: API wrapper mapping frontend prompt/category types to backend types and performing CRUD operations through the actor. Handles data transformation between layers.
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptL: Syncs prompts and categories with backend after authentication, merges with local state, and provides wrapped save/delete operations. Clears local data on logout and handles backend errors.
frontend/src/features/categories/categor: Zustand store managing category list with add, rename, delete, set, and clear operations.
frontend/src/features/clipboard/useCopyT: Hook providing a copy-to-clipboard function with fallback and state for copy status.
frontend/src/features/importExport/expor: Exports prompts and categories to a JSON file with metadata.
frontend/src/features/importExport/impor: Imports prompt data from a JSON file, validates it, and resolves ID collisions.
frontend/src/features/importExport/schem: Defines export data structure and validates imported prompt data.
Filters prompts by favorites, category, and case‑insensitive search query.
frontend/src/features/prompts/id.ts: Generates unique prompt IDs using timestamp and random string.
frontend/src/features/prompts/promptStor: Zustand store handling prompt CRUD, duplication, favorites, and category updates.
frontend/src/features/prompts/sorting.ts: Provides multiple sorting modes for prompts including date, alphabetical, and favorites.
frontend/src/features/prompts/types.ts: Defines Prompt interface and related view and sort mode types.
frontend/src/features/richText/htmlToPla: Converts HTML content to plain text by stripping tags and normalizing whitespace.
frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeH: Sanitizes HTML to allow safe formatting, preserving colors and basic structure.
frontend/src/features/richText/SimpleRic: Rich text editor component supporting bold, italic, colors, and sanitized paste handling.
frontend/src/features/storage/localStora: Loads and saves UI preference data, specifically view mode, to localStorage.
frontend/src/features/storage/useAutoPer: React hook that auto‑persists view mode changes to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to user identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Defines a React auth context/provider using Dfinity AuthClient to manage Internet Identity login, stored identities, and login status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and custom OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/favicon.ts: Deprecated no-op function kept for backwards compatibility; favicon now set via static HTML links.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions to read, persist, clear, and manipulate URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH color tokens, extended utilities, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file describing prompt library requirements, existing features, issues, and new requests.
